messages:
sophie: Hey team — quick question. I'm transferring from the US team to the UK office in early July and expecting in August. How does Redwood handle parental leave timing across an international transfer? Do I keep US leave start dates or switch to UK policy?
ali: Congrats, Sophie! :tada: Short answer: eligibility/entitlement usually follows the country of employment at the time leave starts. If you physically move and are put on UK payroll before your leave begins, UK rules apply.
jordan: This was my worry too — if Sophie signs off US payroll on June 25 and UK payroll starts July 1, which rules govern a due date Aug 10?
michelle: @sophie @jordan correct — it's based on employment location when the leave commences. Important bits: benefits/top-up, statutory pay, and paperwork differ. We'll need a payroll cutover plan so there's no gap in statutory credits.
ali: Action items we usually do: 1) confirm last US payroll date, 2) confirm UK payroll start date, 3) choose leave start date relative to that boundary, 4) file appropriate leave forms in the country where it starts.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: submit international transfer checklist here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/INTL-TRANSFER-CHECKLIST
sophie: If I want to keep US FMLA protections, can I start leave before the transfer instead of after? Would that be allowed?
michelle: Yes, you can. If you start leave while still on US payroll, FMLA and US-based Redwood top-up apply. But note visa/immigration timing — starting leave before relocating can affect proposed start dates for the UK role. Recommend coordinating with hiring/immigration so your relocation date and leave start date are consistent.
ali: Also note payroll timing and taxes: starting leave under US payroll means US payroll taxes and benefits will be used for that period. When UK payroll picks up, your benefits deductions and statutory contributions will switch. We'll coordinate with payroll to avoid double deductions.
jordan: For coverage/backfill: Sophie said she can be remote for a bit before relocation. What should we plan for oncall and handoffs?
sophie: I can do a two-week overlap remotely before leaving. I prefer to take leave starting Aug 1 to align with childcare and travel. Is that feasible?
michelle: That should be feasible. We'll need: a) official leave request form submitted via the HR portal, b) confirmation of payroll cutover dates, c) manager sign-off for overlap/backfill. I'll draft the paperwork checklist.
ali: Example email we use to notify payroll and immigration (paste this into the HR portal):
```
Subject: International transfer + planned parental leave
Employee: Sophie L.
Current payroll: US (last pay date: 2025-06-25)
New payroll: UK (start date: 2025-07-01)
Requested parental leave start: 2025-08-01
Notes: Requesting 12 weeks statutory leave under US or UK depending on start date; prefer to begin under US payroll if possible. Please advise on forms and tax implications.
```
michelle: I'll handle the payroll notify and cc legal for any visa implications. @sophie — ping me your preferred dates and attach passport/visa timeline to the ticket.
sophie: Thanks — filing the HR portal request now and uploading my docs. Really appreciate the help. :heart:
people-ops-bot: Ticket HR-4821 created: International transfer + parental leave (assigned: michelle).
